class.name: SteamHttpRequest
class.brief_description: Branchable draft for one URL and HTTP method.
class.description: Use [method send] to submit the draft and retain a cancellable operation. Each option returns an independent draft.

method.name: accept_json
method.description: Return a branch with the request's Accept header set to [code]application/json[/code].

method.name: with_header
method.description: Return a branch with a request header. Header names are case-insensitive, and a new value replaces the same header on that branch. Steam manages framing and connection headers.

method.name: with_timeout
method.description: Return a branch with an absolute deadline from 100 to 120,000 milliseconds. The default is 15,000 milliseconds.

method.name: with_max_response_bytes
method.description: Return a branch with a response body limit from 1 byte to 4 MiB. The default is 1 MiB. Larger bodies return a limit error and expose no partial response.

method.name: with_response_headers
method.description: Return a branch that replaces the selected response header names. Select up to 16 additional names. Matching ignores case, and Content-Type is captured when present. A selected field larger than 2,048 bytes returns a limit error.

method.name: with_body
method.description: Return a branch that owns raw bytes and their media type for POST, PUT, or PATCH. The body limit is 1 MiB. This media type supplies the request's Content-Type header.

method.name: send
method.description: Submit this draft on its original Steam client scope. Invalid drafts and stopped scopes return already-settled failures.
